tei:div.tei:p: (121)dang po'i las can mkhas pa'i tshul la 'jug pa'i sgo zhes bya ba/ (122)0(10000010000bla ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// phung po skye mched khams rten 'brel// gnas dang gnas min mkhas bya'i gnas// gzugs dang tshor ba 'du shes dang*// 'du byed rnam par shes pa la// phung po lnga zhes rab tu brjod// gzugs ni gzugs 'ung mtshan nyid can// dbye na rgyu gzugs 'bras gzugs so// rgyu gzugs sa chu me rlung bzhi// 'bras gzugs dbang yul rnam rig min// mig rna sna lce lus dbang lnga// yul la gzugs sgra dri ro reg /gzugs la dbyibs dang kha dog gnyis// ring thung mtho dman lham zlum dang*// phyal dang phyal min dbyibs gzugs brgyad// sngo ser dkar dmar rtsa ba'i mdog /sprin dang du ba rdul khug sna// nyi sgrib snang mun yan lag brgyad// sgra la zin dang ma zin dang*// lung du ston dang mi ston dang*// yid 'ong mi 'ong rnam pa brgyad// dri la lhan skyes sbyar byung gnyis// zhim dang mi zhim rnam pa bzhi// ro la mngar skyur kha dang bska// tsha dang lan tshwa rnam pa drug reg bya 'byung dang 'byung 'gyur gnyis// sra gsher drod g.yo 'byung ba'i reg /'jam rtsub lci yang bkres skom grang*// 'byung 'gyur reg bya bdun (123)yin no// rnam rig min la rnam pa gsum// sdom dang sdom min bar ma ste// de bzhin zag med bsam gtan skyes// bstan yod thogs bcas gzugs dang ni// bstan du med la thogs bcas gzugs// bstan med thogs med gzugs dang gsum// tshor ba nyams myong mtshan nyid can// so skye'i tshor ba sdug bsngal ba// yang na lus tshor sems tshor gnyis// yang na bde sdug bar ma gsum// lus sems kun byang dbye bas bzhi// lus tshor bde dang sdug bsngal dang*// yid bde mi bde btang snyoms lnga// mig nas yid bar reg tshor drug /bde sdug bar dbyes bco brgyad do// kun byang dbye bas so drug la// dus gsum dbye bas brgya dang brgyad// 'du shes yul la mtshan mar 'dzin// dbye na mtshan 'dzin mtshan ma med// mtshan 'dzin che chung tshad med gsum// phyi ma mtshan ma med par 'dzin// 'du byed mngon par 'du byed pa// dbye na mtshungs ldan mtshungs ldan min// sems dang sems byung mtshungs lngas mtshungs// sems byung lnga bcu nga gcig las// rtsod pa'i rtsa bar gyur phyir dang*// 'khor ba'i rgyu phyir rim rgyu'i phyir// tshor 'du logs su phung por bzhag

/lhag ma zhe dgu 'dir bsdu'o// dmigs rnam rten rdzas dus mtshungs lnga// dmigs (124)pa gtso sems yul gang la// dmigs nas skye na 'khor sems byung*// de la dmigs nas skye bar mtshungs// rnam pa rnam ldan skye bar mtshungs// rten ni dbang po la brten skye// rdzas ni blo rdzas rigs mthun pa// dus ni skye 'gag dus mtshungs nyid// sems byung lnga bcu nga gcig las// tshor 'du sems pa reg yid byed// 'di dag kun 'gro lnga yin no// sems pa yul gyi rnam pa ni// nang du sems par byed pa'o// reg pa yul la spyod pa ste// dbang yul shes gsum 'phrad par byed// yid byed yul la gtod pa ste// yul gyi rnam pa la dmigs pa// 'dun mos dran ting shes rab te// yul rnams so sor nges pa lnga// 'dun pa bsam pa'i dngos po 'dod// mos pa nges pa'i dngos po la// nges par 'dzin nas yid ches pa// dran pa 'dres pa mi brjed pa// ting 'dzin dmigs par rtse gcig pa// shes rab chos rab 'byed pa'o// dad dang ngo tsha shes khrel yod// ma chags ma sdang gti mug med// brtson 'grus bag yod shin tu sbyangs// btang snyoms rnam par mi 'tshe dang*// bcu gcig po ni dge ba'o// dad pa sems rab dwangs ba ste// dbye na dang 'dod yid ches gsum// ngo tsha shes pa bdag (125)nyid dam// chos kyis dbang byas nyes par 'dzem// khrel yod 'jig rten dbang byas te// nyes pa la ni 'dzem pa'o// ma chags chags med dge ba'i rtsa// mi sdang zhe sdang med pa dang*// gti mug med pa rmongs med do// brtson 'grus le lo'i gnyen po ste// nem nur g.yel med chos la 'jug /bag yod bag med gnyen po ste// nyes par bag zon bcas pa'o// shin sbyangs lus sems las su rung*// btang snyoms dgag sgrub phyogs gnyis btang*// tshad med tshor ba 'du byed kyi// btang snyoms gsum las phyi ma yin// rnam par mi 'tshe gzhan dag la// 'tshe ba'i sems las log pa'o// 'dod chags khong khro nga rgyal dang*// ma rig the tshom lta ba ste// rtsa ba'i nyon mongs drug yin no// 'dod chags yid du 'ong ba la// chags nas 'bral bar dka' ba'o// khong khro yid du mi 'ong bar// sdang nas mnar bar sems pa'o// nga rgyal gzhan las mtho ba'i sems// dbye na rang las dman pa la// bdag lhag snyam pa'i nga rgyal rtsam// mnyam las lhag snyam lhag pa'i dang*// che las lhag snyam nga rgyal las// lhan skyes ngar 'dzin nga'o snyam// rang las (126)ches mchog gyur pa dang*// cung zad tsam gyi khyad par du// snyam pa cung zad nga rgyal dang*// yon tan mngon rlom mngon pa'i dang*// skyon la yon tan du rlom pa// log pa'i nga rgyal bcas te bdun// ma rig mi shes mi gsal ba// kun nas nyon mongs pa yi sems// dbye na bden pa dkon mchog dang*// las 'bras rmongs pa'i ma rig gsum// yang na lhan skyes kun brtags gnyis// the tshom nges pa ma rnyed pa'i// rnam pa blo rtse gnyis pa'o// lta ba dngos po'i gnas lugs la// log par mthong ba lta ba'o// dbye na 'jig mthar log par lta// lta dang tshul brtul mchog 'dzin lnga// dang po 'jig lta nyi shu ni// gzugs ni bdag yin bdag gzugs ldan// bdag la gzugs gnas gzugs la ni// bdag gnas de bzhin tshor sogs la// phung po bdag tu lta ba lnga// bdag gir lta ba bco lnga'o// mthar 'dzin lta ba bzhi'am brgyad// log lta sgro skur phyogs gnyis te// de dag lta ba'i kun sbyor gsum// phyi ma 'dzin pa'i kun sbyor gnyis// lta ba lnga dang lta min lngar// srid pa'i phra rgyas bcu zhes bya// khro dang 'khon 'dzin 'chab dang 'tshig

phrag dog ser sna g.yo sgyu rgyags// rnam (127)'tshe ngo tsha khrel med pa// rmugs dang rgod dang ma dad dang*// le lo bag med brjed ngas che// rnam g.yeng shes bzhin ma yin pa// nyi shu pa ni nye nyon no// khro ba sdang ba'i sems 'chang ba'i// rnam 'gyur lus ngag gsal ba'o// 'khon 'dzin sngar 'khon yid la 'dzin// 'chab pa nyes pa mi brjod gsang*// 'tshig pa khong 'khrug bzhin du gnas// phrag dog gzhan gong gtong mi bzod// ser sna nor rdzas mi gtong 'dzin// g.yo ni gzhan mgo bskor bar bsam// sgyu ni bslu ba'i thabs la sems// rgyags pa sems ni khengs pa ste// dbye na thos dang lang tshos rgyags// rigs gzugs dbang thang rgyags pa lnga// rnam 'tshe mi bde sbyor bar sems// ngo tsha med pa bdag dang chos// dbang byas nyes pa la mi len// khrel med gzhan ngor nyes mi 'dzem// rmugs pa sems la mun pa babs// rgod pa 'dod sar sems 'phro ba// ma dad log lta sems rnyog can// le lo bya ba phyi bshol te// dbye na bya ba ngan zhen dang*// sgyid lug pa yi le lo gnyis// bag med nyes par dogs zon med// brjed ngas sngar 'dris dngos po bskyud// rnam g.yeng shes pa yul phyir g.yeng*// shes bzhin (128)ma yin shes rab rgyun// dran pas ma zin lus pa'o// gnyid 'gyod rtog dpyod gzhan 'gyur bzhi// gnyid ni lus sems bzung mi btub// 'gyod pa med las sems phyir phyogs// reg pa don gyi ngo bo 'dzin// dpyod pa don gyi khyad par dpyod// 'di bzhi dge sdig gzhan dbang can// mtshungs ldan min pa'i 'du byed ni// thob dang ma thob rigs mthun pa// 'du shes med dang de'i snyoms 'jug 'gog pa'i snyoms 'jug srog gi dbang*// skye dang rga dang gnas pa dang*// mi rtag ming dang tshig gi tshogs// yi ge'i tshogs dang bcu bzhi'o// rnam shes yul rig mtshan nyid can// dbye na tshogs drug re rer yang*// dmigs rnam skye ba'i go rim dang*// byed las gang gi ngo bo las// dmigs pa yul la dmigs nas skye// rnam pa yul gyi rnam ldan du// go rim dbang shes skad cig ma// dang po 'gags pa'i gnyis pa dang*// yid shes dang po rang dus mnyams// skad cig se gol gcig gi yun// drug cu'i cha gcig dus mtha'i dang*// de brgya nyi shur de'i skad cig

/bya ba rdzogs pa bya rdzogs te// de la ring thung ma nges pa// byed las dbang por brten nas yul// mthong bar byed la ngo bo ni// yul (129)re+ig pa yi mtshan nyid can// dbang po nyi shu rtsa gnyis las// gzugs phung gis bsdus dbang po ni// gzugs can lnga ste pho mo'i dbang*// tshor phung bde sdug yid bde dang*// mi bde btang snyoms dbang po lnga// ldan min 'du byed srog gi dbang*// rnam shes yid kyi dbang po ste// bcu bzhi gtso bor kun nyon phyogs// mtshungs ldan 'du byed kyis bsdus pa'i// dad btson dran ting shes rab dang*// sbyor lam kun shes byed pa dang*// mthong lam kun shes pa'i dbang po// sgom lam yan chad kun shes dang*// ldan pa brgyad ni rnam byang phyogs// skye mched bcu gnyis phyi yi drug /gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos// mig nas yid bar nang gi drug /rigs sam khams la bco brgyad las// gzugs nas chos bar phyi yul drug /mig nas yid bar nang dbang drug /gsang ba rnam shes khams drug bcas// de ltar gzugs kyi phung po dang*// yid kyi skye mched chos kyi khams// gsum gyis shes bya'i chos rnams bsdus// rten 'brel kun byang phyogs gnyis las// dang por phyi nang phyi la'ang*// rgyu rkyen gnyis las rgyu dang 'brel// sa bon myu gu 'dab ma dang*// sbu gu snying po me tog 'bras// rkyen sa chu (130)me rlung mkha' dus// nang gi rgyu dang rten 'brel ni// ma rig 'du byed rnam shes dang*// ming gzugs skye mched reg tshor ba// sred len srid pa skye rga shi// ma rig sred len nyon mongs lam// 'du byed srid pa las kyi lam// lhag ma bdun ni rnam smin lam// de gsum nyon mongs las dang ni// skye ba'i kun nas nyon mongs brjod// ma rig 'du byed tshe sngon ma// skye ba rga shi phyi ma'i skabs// lhag ma brgyad ni bar ma'i skabs// rkyen ni nang gi sa chu dang*// me rlung nam mkha' sems te drug

/rnam byang lam dang 'bras bu gnyis// rga shi skye ba las byung nas// srid rtsa'i ma rig lhan skyes kyi// dngos gnyen lam bden gtso bo ni// zag med shes rab tshul ting 'khor// des ni srid pa'i rten cing 'brel// rtsa ba bcad pa'i yal ga bzhin// 'bras bu'i rten 'brel lam des ni// mthong sgom spang bya mtha' dag spangs// rnam mkhyen ye shes mngon byas nas// 'brel ba gsum gyis gzhan don mdzad// gnas dang gnas min rnam gzhag la// rgyu 'bras bden pa rnam pa gnyis// dang po las dang rgyu rkyen 'bras// las la lus ngag yid gsum mam// dge dang mi dge mi g.yo ba// yang na (131)lung ma bstan dang gsum// dge bar bsod nams cha mthun dang*// tshogs lam thar pa cha mthun dang*// sbyor lam nges 'byed mthong lam yan// zag med dge ba bzhir dbye'am// ngo bo nyid dang mtshungs par ldan// kun nas bslang dang don dam bzhi// mi dge ba la de bzhir dbye// nyon mongs rnams dang de ldan pa'i// sems dang sems byung des bskyed pa'i// lus ngag las dang 'khor ba rnams// lung ma bstan la rnam smin skyes// spyod lam pa dang bzo yi gnas// sprul pa'i sems dang rnam pa bzhi// rgyu ni rnam par bzhag pa ni// byed rgyu lhan cig 'byung ba dang*// skal mnyam mtshungs par ldan pa dang*//

mtshungs pa lnga mtshungs par kun tu 'gro dang rnam smin no// rgyu ni rnam pa drug tu 'dod// rkyen ni bzhi ste rgyu dang ni// dmigs pa yul dang ni de ma thag snga ma 'gag ma thag byed rgyu dang bdag po yang ni de bzhin no// 'bras bu rnam smin rgyu mthun dang*// dbang dang skyes bu byed pa'i 'bras// bral ba'i 'bras bu dang ni lnga// bden pa bzhi dang bden gnyis las// sdug kun 'gog lam bden pa bzhi// sdug bsngal bden pa'i rnam pa bzhi// mi rtag sdug bsngal stong bdag med// kun 'byung las nyon gnyis po la// rgyu (132)dang kun 'byung rab skye rkyen// brtags dang brtags min 'gog pa gnyis// 'gog zhi gya nom nges par 'byung*// lam la byang phyogs so bdun dang*// 'bras bu stobs sogs zag med chos// lam rigs sgrub pa nges par 'byin// bden pa gnyis kyi rnam gzhag la// grub mtha' bzhi yi dbang byas te// theg dman bye brag smra bas ni// gang la bcom dang blo yis gzhan// bsal na de blo mi 'jug pa// bum chu bzhin du kun rdzob tu// yod de don dam yod gzhan no// gzhig dang gzhal bas rang 'dzin blo// 'dor rung kun rdzob bden pa ste// ldog pa don dam bden par bzhed// theg dman mdo sde ba ltar na// don byed nus pa gang yin pa// de 'dir don dam yod pa yin// gzhan ni kun rdzob yod pa ste// de dag rang spyi'i mtshan nyid bshad// spyi mtshan dngos med 'dus ma byas// rtag pa kun rdzob bden pa rnams// don gcig rtog pa bcas pa'i yul// rang mtshan dngos po mi rtag pa// 'dus byas don dam bden pa rnams// don gcig rtog med mngon sum yul// theg chen sems tsam bden pa gnyis// dper na thag khrar sbrul 'khrul dus// thag khrar sbrul lo (133)snyam pa bzhin// yul dang yul gyi ming rnams ni// kun brtags zhes brjod thag khra bzhin// sems dang sems byung gzhan dbang ste// de dag kun rdzob bden par 'dod// thag khrar sbrul ni ma grub pa// yongs grub kyis bsdus gzung dang 'dzin// gnyis stong rang rig rang gsal bas// don dam bden pa yin par 'dod// theg pa chen po dbu ma pas// rten cing 'brel 'byung gang yinapa// de ni stong pa nyid du brjod// de la brten nas gdags pa ste// de ni dbu ma'i lam yin no// rten cing 'brel 'byung ma yin pa'i// chos 'ga' yod pa ma yin no// de phyir stong nyid ma yin pa'i// chos 'ga' yod pa ma yin no// gzhi grub rten 'byung gis khyab cing*// rten 'byung stong pa nyid kyis khyab// kun rdzob rten 'byung bslu ba med// don dam spros bral stong pa nyid// theg chen mtha' dag mdor bsdu na// chos lnga dang ni rang bzhin gsum// rnam shes brgyad dang bdag med gnyis// theg chen sdom bzhi'i chos lnga ni// ka bum la sogs ming dang ni// gdung 'degs don byed sogs rgyu mtshan// de la mtshan 'dzin 'khrul pa la// rtogs pa tshul (134)bzhin rtogs pa la// yang dag pa yi ye shes dang*// chos rnams gnas lugs de bzhin nyid// kun brtags la yang ri rwa sogs// mtshan nyid chad pa'i kun brtags dang*// rten 'brel can gyi chos thams cad// rnam grangs pa yi kun brtags gnyis// gnyis 'dzin blo yis snang ba rnams// ma dag pa yi gzhan dbang dang*// snod bcud dag par snang ba la// dag pa'i gzhan dbang rnam pa gnyis// chos kyi gnas lugs de kho na// 'gyur ba med pa'i yongs grub dang*// ji ltar yin pa de ltar rtogs// phyin ci ma log yongs grub gnyis// ming dang rgyu mtshan kun brtags la// rnam par rtog pa gzhan dbang dang*// yang dag ye shes de bzhin nyid// yongs grub kyis bsdus rang bzhin gsum// rnam shes brgyad ni tshogs drug steng*// len pa'i rnam shes zab cing phra// sa bon chu bo'i rgyun bzhin 'bab// bdag tu rtog na mi rung gis// byis pa rnams la ngas ma bstan// zhes gsungs ma bsgribs lung ma bstan// sems ni kun shes rnam shes so// ngar sems pa ni nyon yid do// thun mong 'khor ni kun 'gro lnga// rang gi thun mong min pa'i 'khor// bdag tu rmongs dang bdag tu lta/

(135)/bdag tu nga rgyal bdag tu chags// 'khor dgur mtshungs ldan kun gzhir dmigs// bdag tu 'dzin pa'i sems yin no// bdag med gnyis kyi gang zag bdag /phung po gcig dang tha dad par// med par rtogs pa dang po yin// gzung ba rdul dang 'dzin pa ni// skad cig phyogs dus chas dbye bas// rang bzhin med par rtogs pa ni// chos kyi bdag med rnam par bzhag /theg chen dbu ma'i lta ba la// rtog pa rnam par chad pa na// bden pa dbyer med de kho na// rnam grangs ma yin don dam gang*// thabs lam zab mo ngo 'phrod pa// rdo rje theg pa'i khyad par yin// 'od gsal rgyud sde nas gsungs pa'i// sems dang ye shes rnam pa gnyis// yul rig tsam du gcig mod de// yul phyir 'brang nas zhen pa dang*// mi rtog rang ngo shes pas dbye// yid dang shes rab gnyis po yang*// rig pa'i rtsal du gcig na yang*// gzung 'dzin bden par zhen pa dang*// shar grol thad kar chod pas phye// kun gzhi dang ni chos sku gnyis// rig pa nyid du gcig gyur kyang*// glo bur dri mas bsgribs pa dang*// rang ngo ka (136)dag ldog pas dbye// kun gzhi yid dang sems gsum po// lhan skyes ma rig mtshungs ldan 'khor// chos sku shes rab ye shes gsum// lhan skyes ye shes mtshungs ldan 'das// 'khor 'das rig pa'i gzhi la gcig /rig dang ma rig khyad par ro// legs bshad sbrang rtsi'i zil mngar 'di// lung rtogs bstan pa'i nyi ma yis// rigs dang chos kyis bsrung ba'i bu// bshad sgrub bstan pa'i nyi ma yi// skyes thob lang tshos sgeg pa'i slad// kun mkhyen ngag gi dbang po yis// rjes su bzung ba'i skal ba can// 'jam dpal grub pa'i blo gros sam// brda sprod kun bshad btags ming du// sgra dbyangs pad+ma'i myu gus bris// dge bas mar gyur yid can kun// spobs pa'i gter brgyad thob gyur cig /sarba maṅga lam/// /
